column1: # bridge/nvml/derived.tsv: files of CUDApp compat/nvml that this tree does not store, because a program makes them.
# One row per (generator, file). bridge/nvml/gate.om reads this table (tests/gates/run.sh bridge-nvml).
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   status     derived: made from source by the generator, never stored here
#   file       the file's name in CUDApp compat/nvml
#   mode       the bridge-seeded mode (lib-c, lib-h, lib-map; the request's first byte L, M, V)
#   source     the Omega source in this tree
#   source_sha256     SHA-256 of source
#   generator_sha256  SHA-256 of the omega-bridge src/toc.om that emits it (cabi-1)
#   output_sha256     SHA-256 of the emitted file
#   cudapp     the committed file in CUDApp (commit 84b524cadaaa8bc9b556adfaea9d6dd2e0d67a66) with these bytes, or -
# Generators:
#   218214ab... omega-bridge commit 9172b525cdf0c521e2d717d17d0dfc818592d7c2 ("cabi-1: C ABI library emitter"),
#               the pin CABI_CONVERTER_PIN of CUDApp om/omega-bridge-cabi.lock; its output is CUDApp's committed bytes.
#   1ae9b9bc... omega-bridge main 0138839cc3e7aef1c77230505f757372b8ae6ad5; its output differs from the 218214ab
#               output in line 1 only, the generator digest the emitter writes into the header comment.
